summary: Form checkbox with a slotted label, optional supporting text and an indeterminate state; use for independent on/off choices.

usage.text: The indeterminate attribute is a display and ARIA state only. A user toggle clears it, it does not change what the form receives, and form reset restores it.
The required attribute is satisfied only while checked.

a11y.text: The slotted label text is copied to the input as a plain-text aria-label; an aria-label on the host overrides it. Text in the supporting slot is visible but is not linked as a description.
